# console.device RawKeyConvert, measured on real Kickstart 3.1 (40.63,
# A600, 68000) under Copperline with tools/rawkeyprobe/ and the
# ROM's built-in default (usa) keymap. One line per call:
#   <label> <actual> <bytes written, hex>
# kCC/qQQQQ = a single key-down event, raw code CC, ie_Qualifier QQQQ;
# dDD/kCC/qQQQQ = the same with ie_Prev1DownCode DD, ie_Prev1DownQual
# IEQUALIFIER_LALT (a dead key). 64-byte buffer. Some labels dump four
# bytes whatever <actual> is, so 0xEE there is untouched buffer. Read by
# crates/volamos-core/src/console.rs's tests.
